subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which Gateway/model/provider contract and security fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but automation should not choose the product API shape, raw-media egress policy, provider capability gates, or fallback semantics for direct video uploads.

options.title: Approve first-class chat video input
options.body: Define one coherent WebChat, Gateway, model-catalog, provider-serialization, fallback, security, docs, and test contract for native video upload.

options.title: Keep video in media understanding
options.body: Treat the existing video description pipeline as the supported path and document that direct chat-native video blocks are not planned yet.

options.title: Prove provider-specific paths first
options.body: Let provider-owned implementations such as MiniMax or Google prove native video behavior before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class chat video input
recommendation.body: Define one coherent WebChat, Gateway, model-catalog, provider-serialization, fallback, security, docs, and test contract for native video upload.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest visible routing context for the existing product/security decision on this issue, while current-line ownership is shared.
